headline: Nigeria Approves N70,000 Transport Allowance for Federal Workers
summary: The administration of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved an N70,000 transport allowance for federal workers. The relief initiative follows rising cost-of-living challenges stemming from the earlier removal of the petrol subsidy.
why: Fuel subsidy removal and currency reforms in Nigeria have sharply elevated living costs, pushing the federal government to implement compensatory fiscal allowances for public employees.
